resource_limits: Compile with SCM_HYPOTHESIS_NO_HOST_IO for a callback-only codec. The target NVM commit-marker/inactive-slot/acquisition implementation is not supplied or qualified by this codec.
Host FILE/libc internals and524-byte temporary-path frame are additional host costs. Complete target software-math/caller/IRQ stack and35Hz timing remain unmeasured.
source_identity_caution: The first development run did not snapshot source hashes. These are review-time hashes, not a claim that later-edited core bytes built the earlier binary. Integrated qualification freezes exact sources and binary separately before primary.

final_audit.method: Read-only source and existing compiler stack-report review. No compiler, test, smoke, estimator, primary, or scorer execution.

resolved_orchestration_guards.evidence: Coincident comparisons now use emitted mean, coordinate_sd, evidence_next_index, point_available, capacity_available, local_ranges_available, rejected_voltage_count, limited_gain_count, and zero_gain_count fields plus equal log weights. All named fields are emitted by tools/hypothesis_probe.c:emit_component.

Each existing required record must be exactly 3004 bytes; checkpoint_files_complete compares the collected indices against all three planned indices [31500,63000,73500] and is included in functional_passed.

Runner records git rev-parse source_revision:data/manifest.json as truth_manifest_git_blob without reading manifest contents. After both inference attempts close and source/output hashes pass, scorer compares git hash-object of the current manifest with that frozen blob identity before truth-bearing imports or manifest parse.

stack_account.scope: Conservative additive sums of compiler-reported own-source frames along the listed call chains for this host build. These are partial storage accounts, not whole-program high-water measurements or target qualification.
stack_account.report_provenance: Existing build/hypothesis-stack/*.su reports supplied by integrated qualification. This audit does not rerun compilation or infer target ABI behavior from host frames.
call_graph_notes: component_payload and real_array have no separate reported frames; their work is included in payload. decode_stage is inlined into the callback-only public decode but has its own 112-byte frame in the host-enabled build.
The integer -> u32 -> bytes path has the same 128-byte subtotal as real -> u64 -> bytes. Header and checksum routes are smaller.

Validation is sequential with payload processing, not nested under payload. Its largest listed own-source subchain is validate 48 + normalized_weights 48 = 96 bytes before libm, smaller than payload 96 + real 48 + u64 48 + bytes 32 = 224 bytes before callback.
The 524-byte temporary pathname array and codec contexts/scalar buffers are already included in the measured save/encode/decode frames; do not add them again.
Core aggregate-query code is being amended separately. This audit uses its report only for unchanged validator frame references and makes no current aggregate-query stack claim.
conditional_arithmetic: Callback-only decode 128 + 96 + 48 + 48 + 32 = 352 excludes its caller and external callback implementation.
excluded_or_unqualified: External callback implementation and its owned storage, libc/stdio FILE objects, buffering beyond named buffers, libc/libm frames and hidden runtime allocations.
Program startup and caller context outside listed chains, compiler/ABI changes, target software math, acquisition/driver state, interrupt nesting and IRQ stack.
Target NVM inactive-slot commit protocol, power-loss behavior, 35 Hz timing, and full Cortex-M23 SRAM/stack qualification.
The 9624-byte subtotal is not proof that a complete subsystem fits 10240 bytes; design stack reserves remain unvalidated until target measurements include excluded costs.
